title: Archive serializer source repairs and retained timing-review history
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Archive the completed serializer source-repair round in `research/h25-o03-source-repair-20261101`, including the complete frozen source, independent AI source review, exact named review inputs, and retained checker/rejection history. The archive supplies conditional byte/framing and provider-dependent auxiliary-space analysis, a minimal four-region primary-exception hardening draft, a 23-row conditional provider-closure/acquisition plan, and a bounded timing parser/readback v2 with literal expectations. The retained source index maps these subjects to the historical W1–W4 labels.

The timing-parser v1 rejection is preserved. Its admitted literal `179.990000000000000000000000001 + .01` is exactly greater than 180, but ambient Decimal precision could round away the violation. The sole accepted source repair uses an isolated precision-128 context and a conservative 60-aligned-digit argument. Original v1 source, 330 payloads, 47 variants/oracles, and the rejection remain unchanged; v2 adds 12 unexecuted variants.

This is **source/review archival intake only**. All target executions are **0**; all 50 framing proposals, 14 primary-error proposals per normal/-O mode, and the timing parser's 30 case labels / 59 variants remain **unexecuted**. No source is adopted, current runtime seal or new admission/termination/completion producer is integrated, runtime execution remains **unadmitted**, authentic serializer qualification remains **not qualified**, no measured gain or κ improvement is claimed, and complete physical cost remains **OPEN_NOT_ZERO**. Source-content freezing is distinct from runtime custody.

## Task and overlap

Originating benchmark or verification contribution: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessor: [PR #6332](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6332).

Initial submission instruction (historical): publish the accepted source work as a scoped draft PR, retaining the execution and authentic serializer qualification limitations; scope unchanged. Canonical base: `626e936ce4d61f2584316914fc71baf96940c512` (tree `8a494528760f84901011187e0351934e001e2eea`). Exact predecessor pins are A `85fa502d063c132a48eadeb4dc8a188e668a88e0`, S `90df75ee32d0c51acbcc5b63ebbe6f26011ee92b`, B `e05aad954689d0ee21baff19b4674f1fcb2e838f`, and separate inventory context `c95f76dfad324e6488a88dab9988ce534ee2a481`.

This source-only successor to [PR6332](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6332) adds the specified conditional analysis, narrow diagnostic source repair, provider plan, and timing source repair. [PR6326](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6326), [PR6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029), and [PR5864](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5864) retain their separate component/baseline lineage. [PR6328](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6328) is supporting inventory context, with no serializer performance credit transferred.

## Validation

The package preserves all 525 files / 2,155,033 bytes of the closed local round byte for byte. Named original source/text inputs are copied or explicitly mapped to identical archived attachments; full predecessor packages and approximately 17 MB of authentic transports are external exact public references. Historical absolute paths and original modes are recorded, not rewritten into runnable paths. Exported Git modes are 100644. No standalone execution or source-history ancestry claim is made.

Offline metadata command, from the repository root with standard-library Python 3:

```sh
python3 -I -S -B research/h25-o03-source-repair-20261101/check_archive.py
```

This checks its own manifest and regular-file byte sizes, SHA-256 and Git blob IDs only. Independent passive export identity checks passed for all 575 files against the frozen manifest, transfer records and original source bytes; no candidate was imported, parsed, compiled or run, no fixture JSON was generically decoded, and no control, authentic decoder, benchmark or runtime probe was executed. The archive uses the current guide's archive-format option and registers **no VERIFY.json replay hook**. Hosted CI/publication checks, if present, are separate from scientific validation.

Publication export v1 was rejected on the sole packaging metadata finding PUB-META-001: six ancestral aliases recorded the source-copy mode rather than the named original mode. The separate v2 snapshot corrects only those six recorded values to `0o664` and dependent export-manifest hashes. The rejected v1 snapshot, freeze and review remain preserved; every scientific source, proof, fixture, original mode and all 573 other package files are unchanged.

The retained final independent source review is SHA-256 `a8ecfc1d805e30dff1031f51dc371ea567de962cf4115077dfa55e3e6da8a420`; its freeze is `cee7e0a6891761fe8c1d76f148cf5d78f43f6d0260cb3c0ae9a951fd8b748970`. See the package README, `SOURCE-EXPORT-MANIFEST-v1.json`, `RELOCATION-MAP-v1.json`, and `OUTCOME.json` for exact scope and preserved failure evidence.

## Credit

Chris / Clear1nsight, Douglas R. Colkitt, CrocSwap, and predecessor/parallel contributors in PR6029, PR6326, PR6332, PR6328 and PR5864 retain credit. Source notices are preserved, with Apache-2.0 LICENSE and attribution notice. Substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6.1-sol assistance at max reasoning supported authorship, conditional analysis, separate independent AI source review and export. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is implied.

## Open next questions

See the structured questions in the package `TASK.json` and ordered prerequisites in `archive/integration/NEXT-DEPENDENCIES-v1.json`: select concrete primary-error and timing-parser sources and interfaces; obtain separate authorization for actual-host/provider acquisition and sealing; integrate trusted admission/termination/completion producers and separately admit finite controls; then seek a fresh one-use runtime admission with current custody, ledger, numerical guards and complete cost bill. This publication authorizes none of those steps and does not resume the original goal or automations.
